vocabulary.meaning: the main title of a news story
a person who writes news stories
a piece of writing in a newspaper or online
to send out news on TV or radio
a conversation where questions are asked

grammar_tips.title: Talking about Recent Events
grammar_tips.explanation: Use the present perfect to talk about news: 'The president has visited the city.'

grammar_tips.title: Reporting Speech
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'said' or 'told' to report what someone said: 'The reporter said it was raining.'

grammar_tips.title: Questions about News
grammar_tips.explanation: Start questions with 'What', 'Who', 'When', etc: 'What happened yesterday?'

example_sentences.sentence: I read an interesting article about the environment.
The headline says there was a big storm last night.
There is a new update about the event.
They broadcast the news at 8 o’clock every evening.

vocabulary.question: What is a 'headline'?
options: The end of a news story
The main title of a news story

vocabulary.question: A person who writes news stories is a _____.
What does 'broadcast' mean?
options: To send out news on TV or radio

sentence.question: The reporter _____ (said/asked) there was a fire.
He has _____ (written/read) an article about education.
Arrange: about / news / the / I / heard / accident / the
options: I heard the news about the accident.

sentence.question: Arrange: mayor / the / reporter / the / interviewed

listening.question: Listen: What is the headline about?
Listen: Who did the reporter interview?
Listen: When is the news broadcast?
Listen: What was the event about?
Listen: What did the update say?

speaking.question: Say one recent news event in your city.
speaking.answer: There was a new park opened in my city last week.

speaking.question: Talk about a headline you read today.
speaking.answer: I read a headline about the weather getting warmer.

speaking.question: Describe how you get news updates.
speaking.answer: I get news updates from my phone and TV.

speaking.question: Share something you heard in the news yesterday.
speaking.answer: Yesterday, I heard there was a big festival downtown.

speaking.question: Say why news is important to you.
speaking.answer: News is important because it helps me know what is happening in the world.
